stories.title: Suffocating defense, JSN lift Seahawks to victory
stories.summary: Seattle's bread-and-butter from its Super Bowl championship season -- JSN and defense -- was too much for the Chiefs.

stories.title: OKC's Williams taken off with significant injury
stories.summary: There was no immediate diagnosis from the Thunder on Jalen Williams' injury, with coach Mark Daigneault saying the team would be briefed Monday morning.

stories.title: Packers rip refs after roughing penalties prove costly in loss
stories.summary: Several Packers players lit up the crew that officiated Sunday's game in Detroit, arguing against roughing penalties that have plagued the team all season.

stories.title: Doncic has NBA's first 50-point game of season as Lakers reach 3-0
stories.summary: Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Jazz on Sunday. It was the first 50-point game this season in the NBA.

stories.title: WR Chase's fiery halftime speech inspires Bengals' turnaround vs. Ravens
stories.summary: Ja'Marr Chase unloaded on his Bengals teammates in a halftime speech that inspired Cincinnati to a comeback victory over the Ravens.
